\begin{document}
Throughout, all logarithms are to base 2, so that entropies are measured in bits.
The entanglement entropy of one qubit of a Bell pair is
\begin{equation}
-\frac{1}{2}\log\frac{1}{2} - \frac{1}{2}\log\frac{1}{2} = 1 .
\label{eq:bit}
\end{equation}
